import json
R=[("R1 (Meth.)",4,3,38,1.25,[42,62,52,48,32,55,65]),

("DA",4,2,28,1.25,[36,58,48,44,30,50,60])]
keys=["technical_rigor","clarity","novelty","significance","experimental_validation","reproducibility","ethics"]
def build(w):
    out={"paper_type":"theoretical","reviewers":[]}
    for r in R:
        d={"role":r[0],"confidence":r[1],"overall":r[2]}
        if w: d["eic_weight"]=r[4]

        out["reviewers"].append(d)
    out["da_critical"]=[{"id":"DA-C1","upheld":True,"resolvable_without_new_data":False}]
    return out
json.dump(build(False),open("scores_before.json","w"),indent=2)
json.dump(build(True),open("scores.json","w"),indent=2)
